name: yonglo-website
description: Website van Yonglo: statische pagina's + blogberichten op /post/<naam> (Wix-managed Astro).

scripts.dev: node tools/maak-engels.mjs && node tools/site-bestanden.mjs --met-bijhouden && astro dev
